title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for metastatic liver disease.

HPI
The patient is an 80-year-old male presenting for follow-up regarding his history of colon cancer. He underwent a primary resection and systemic treatment several years ago. He reports feeling generally well today with no new complaints. He notes that his primary site was previously cleared, and he remains stable. The focus of today's visit is the management of liver metastases that have developed.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Atorvastatin 20mg daily
Metformin 500mg twice daily

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. He is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. Abdomen is soft and non-tender without palpable masses. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Heart sounds are regular without murmurs.

Assessment
1. Liver metastases: The patient has metastatic to the liver disease resulting from his previous colon cancer.
2. History of colon cancer: The primary site shows no evidence of local recurrence. Treatment for the primary site is complete.

Plan
We will continue to monitor the liver metastases. The patient will undergo a follow-up imaging study in three months to assess the progression of the malignancy. He was instructed to contact the office if he experiences new abdominal pain or jaundice.

Electronically signed, A. Rivera, NP, 05/14/2026
explanations: The colon cancer was excised or eradicated, no treatment is directed to it and there is no evidence of it: personal history Z85.038 (no HCC). Any metastasis is still coded as a current secondary malignancy.
Liver metastases: C78.7, secondary malignant neoplasm of liver (HCC 17).

distractors.why: Treatment ended and there is no evidence of the primary: code personal history (Z85), not active cancer.
Metastasis is coded as a secondary malignancy, even when the primary is history.
The metastases are in the liver, not bone.

hccs.label: Cancer Metastatic to Lung/Liver/Brain/and Other Organs; Acute Myeloid Leukemia Except Promyelocytic
